description:
Seeking a Developer to provide support for HL7 interface development and also support application development, data migration, Statistical and Management Reporting and Data Exchange processes. 
 
 Must have excellent written and verbal skills and be a team player. Ability to foster good working relationships with team members and users. Ability to work in fast paced public health laboratory environment and manage multiple deadlines. 
 
 Experience in Web application development using .Net is required. 
 Experience in writing complex SQL and writing Oracle PLSQL programs is required. 
 Experience using Crystal 11 reports and Oracle 11G - 12c is preferred. 
 Experience with data modelling and designing logical and normalized databases, web application interfaces and reports that meets user and technical specifications. 
 Should be familiar in using source control tools and issue tracking tools. 
 Experience in HL7 and data integration projects preferred. 
 
 Must be willing to take and pass a criminal/finger print background check. 
 
 Must be willing to sign a confidentiality agreement. 


 
 
 If you are available, interested, planning to make a change, or know of a friend who might have the required qualifications and interest, please call me ASAP at  734-224-6628.
